purpose: Convert non-authoritative CNInfo candidate hints into validated official filing objects and classifier-ready evidence inputs without full-market PDF prefetch.

problem_elimination.avoid: Do not classify from search-result snippets or titles.
problem_elimination.absorb: Reuse V2.7.29 canonical identity and known official locators whenever announcement_id already exists there.
problem_elimination.substitute: For candidate hits absent from the inventory, validate the hit's official CNInfo announcement_id/adjunct_url directly and materialize only that filing.
problem_elimination.precompute_reuse: Content-addressed object cache keyed by raw PDF SHA256; locator-to-object mapping is reusable.
problem_elimination.optimize: Only candidate files are fetched and extracted.

required: canonical_security_id resolvable from exchange stream and security code
candidate belongs to the applicable U-layer security universe when used for a signal date

locator_priority: exact announcement_id match in V2.7.29 primary locator inventory
otherwise validated candidate hit adjunct_url from official CNInfo response

temporal.historical_bootstrap: Development/diagnostic only unless the evidence was prospectively observed before the signal cutoff.
temporal.prospective_activation: Eligibility change starts no earlier than the first trading date after authoritative observation unless an earlier exact availability timestamp is frozen.
